title: MotorList
description: `hpr motors list`: the bundled catalog's motors, with the figures their curve files give.

motors.description: The motors that pass the filters, in catalog order (by impulse class).

tool.title: Tool
tool.description:
The program that wrote a document or a file: the title block every `--json` document, every
file `hpr` writes and `hpr --version` carry (ADR-164; the product system's `data.md`: "Every
export carries the designation and version of the tool that made it").

designation.description: Its designation in the FusionSpace product system: `FS-ACHERNAR · SW · TOOL 001`.

CatalogInfo.description: Where the bundled catalog comes from.

captured.description: The date the curve files were downloaded, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

selection.description: Which motors were taken, and why.

source.description: The source, such as `ThrustCurve.org data files marked public domain`.

ListedMotor.description:
One motor in the catalog: size and delays from its curve file's header, impulse, thrust and burn
time worked out from its curve, as `hpr motors show` and the simulator work them out.

average_thrust_n.description:
Average thrust, N, from the curve (total impulse over the burn time), or ThrustCurve.org's
record's where `curve` is false.

burn_time_s.description:
Burn time, s, from the curve by NFPA 1125, or ThrustCurve.org's record's where `curve` is
false.

curve.description:
Whether a curve file of it is bundled, so `hpr sim --motor` flies it. Without one, its
size and figures are ThrustCurve.org's record's, and it can't fly.

delays.description:
The delays as the curve file's header writes them, such as `6,8,10`, `4-6` or `P`
(plugged).

designation.description: The manufacturer's full designation, such as `1266J760-19A`.

selector.description:
The name that selects this motor alone in `hpr sim --motor` and `hpr motors show`: its
designation, or its maker's short name and its designation where makers share it, such
as `Estes C6` (ADR-302).

total_impulse_ns.description: Total impulse, N·s, from the curve, or ThrustCurve.org's record's where `curve` is false.

MotorKind.description: Whether a motor is used once or reloaded into a reusable case.

oneOf.description: A reload for a reusable case.
A hybrid: listed, but HPR Sim models solid motors only.
